title: Cycle orthogonality splits extensions of acyclic complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $X,Y$ be integer cochain complexes, meaning $d^{n+1}d^n=0$, and put $Z^nX=\ker d_X^n$ and $Z^nY=\ker d_Y^n$. Assume both complexes are acyclic, that is $\operatorname{im}d^{n-1}=\ker d^n$ in every degree. Suppose $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal A}(Z^iX,Z^jY)=0$ for every $i,j\in\mathbf Z$, where this means every short exact extension of $Z^iX$ by $Z^jY$ splits. Then every short exact sequence $0\to Y\to E\xrightarrow{p}X\to0$ in the category of cochain complexes admits a cochain map $s:X\to E$ with $ps=1_X$.
